verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's own docs state it natively supports MCP starting in v0.6.31 and that you can call tools exposed by your MCP server. A Tool Servers admin setting connects external tool servers, and a community user independently lists MCP integration as a feature they depend on. missing for 10: documented detail on supported MCP transports and setup/configuration steps, and hands-on corroboration of tool-calling reliability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Open WebUI natively supports MCP (Model Context Protocol) starting in v0.6.31.
You can now call tools exposed by your MCP server from Open WebUI.
Give the agent tools beyond the built-ins by connecting external tool servers in Settings → Admin → Tool Servers.
